dog.description_text:
Meet Star! This five-month-old yellow Lab puppy is ready to shine bright in her forever home. Star has all the makings of a true little firecracker: cheerful, playful, loving, and full of puppy sparkle.

With her soft yellow coat, wagging tail, and bright-eyed curiosity, Star brings a little extra glow everywhere she goes. Like any young Lab, she is eager to explore, learn, and grow with a family who will give her training, patience, playtime, and plenty of love.

If you are looking for a loyal little star-spangled sweetheart, Star is ready to light up your life.
